title: The class of unconfined systems has the bounded amalgamation property with an explicit bound
author: Silvia Barbina; Enrique Casanovas
work: The elementary theory of free Steiner triple systems
difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled proposition at source lines 740-741: the class of unconfined Steiner triple systems has the bounded amalgamation property for every bound, and in fact the bound can be taken to be the prescribed one plus the number of elements of B outside A. The proof (source lines 742-749) constructs the amalgam rather than citing one: it picks a copy of B over A arranged so that the union with C is unconfined, shows that the union carries an HF-ordering with C as initial segment by concatenating two orderings and analysing the failure case, and only then verifies the bounded condition for the copy inside the amalgam using the two hypotheses. The statement records the property and the explicit bound, and none of the construction.
